name: AnimeCon UK
blurb: The original, flagship AnimeCon UK show and the UK's largest dedicated anime & manga convention, held yearly at the NEC in Birmingham.

editions.evidence: Homepage text: 'ANIMEcon uk is back for our 5th nec show! 12-13 june 2027 nec birmingham' and 'Dates & Times Saturday 12th June 10am – 6pm Sunday 13th June 10am – 5pm'.

notes: The given URL (www.animeconuk.com) is now just a hub page that links out to four separate city sites run by the same Oakham Group (animeconnec.com = NEC/Birmingham = the 'AnimeCon UK' flagship, animeconlondon.com, animeconmanchester.com, animedublin.com — Dublin is not in this research list); this file uses animeconnec.com directly as the official url. The guests page shows one card (Emi Lo) explicitly marked CANCELLED, left over from a past edition, and otherwise says 'COMING SOON', so guests is 'none-yet' for the June 2027 show.
